articles.contents:
Welcome
Hi! My name is Daniela. I am a student at Santa Barbara City College.
I am interested in pain psychology, chronic neuroplastic health conditions, and holistic healing modalities.
A question I care about
How can we support young people who do not have access to effective treatments for chronic pain and other associated conditions? There are ways to reduce symptoms for these conditions, but they are not well studied or implemented in treatment for youth with chronic pain. Holistic healing that includes traditional eastern medicine, psychology, and medication are powerful in reducing symptoms and improving quality of life for there debilitating chronic health conditions.
Something I have learned with data
In Statistics 150, I have learned to use linear regression models to understand the relationship between variables. When using regression, I can see the model’s prediction for the specific outcome value of any predictor value. This prediction is the model’s assumption based off of the line of best fit. With linear regression, I can develop a better concept of the type of relationship between my variables.
